Chapter 720 - 720 Teaching; Setting Up!

Chapter 720 - 720 Teaching; Setting Up!

720 Teaching; Setting Up!

“Did your dad say when he’ll come and save us?” Li Hao asked.

“I didn’t tell Dad about our current situation,” Lin Chengzhen said.

Pausing, he continued, “Even if my dad is really a Universe-level warrior, this is the Dark Universe… You know as well that we used a one-time one-way teleportation array at that time. If Dad wants to come from Earth, I’m afraid it’ll take at least 10,000 years.”

“Also, even if dad really comes over, that Moses is a level-nine Universe master. Besides, Moses has a King-level giant behind him.”

Level-nine Universe, King-level giant!

These existences were like mountains pressing down on them, making them unable to breathe.

Hearing this, Li Hao sighed slightly and said, “That’s true.

“Chengzhen, you were right not to tell your dad.”

“Let’s practice the cultivation method that my dad taught first.” Lin Chengzhen nodded. “Even though the Dark Universe is dangerous, the spiritual energy is extremely pure and abundant. With these techniques, we might be able to break through to the Domain Lord level very quickly!”

“Alright!” Li Hao said.

Speaking of the Domain Lord level, Li Hao’s entire body became excited and filled with anticipation.

…

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

After hearing Lin Chengzhen’s words, Lin Fan did not feel at ease.

On the contrary, the worry on his face became even more intense.

This was because his son was only reporting the good news and not the bad news. He was probably afraid that he would worry.

The more it was like this, the worse the situation was.

He had to think of a way to help his son.

Lin Fan shifted his eyes.

After a while, he turned his attention to Ma Zheng.

Ma Zheng was the Star Lord of Hong Planet.

Back then, under the invitation of Star Lord Qing Song, Ma Zheng and Lin Fan entered the secret realm together to resolve the Bug Queen crisis.

Later on, the two of them entered the Heavenly Wind World together and obtained great benefits.

After that, Ma Zheng was attacked by the Bug Queen and saved by Lin Fan. From that, he had a good impression of Lin Fan.

After that, Lin Fan never contacted Ma Zheng again.

Now, perhaps he could try a few times and make some arrangements.

Hence, Lin Fan used his soul to communicate with Ma Zheng.

“Ma Zheng.”

…

In a spacious cultivation room, Ma Zheng suddenly opened his eyes.

His face was filled with excitement as he called out, “Senior Lin?”

“It’s me. How’s your cultivation recently?” Lin Fan asked.

“Thanks to your help, I’ve already reached the fifth level of the Planet Realm!” Ma Zheng said excitedly.

One had to know…

When he first entered the Heavenly Wind World, Ma Zheng was only at the first level of the Planet Realm.

In just a few decades, he had already reached the fifth level of the Planet Realm!

The speed of his breakthrough could not be considered slow.

No wonder he was so excited.

Lin Fan said, “Level-five Planet? You’re too weak. I’ll teach you a King-level cultivation technique now. Hopefully, that’ll speed up your breakthrough.”

King-level cultivation technique?

Even though Lin Fan was not in front of him.

However, Ma Zheng still knelt on the ground and said in an extremely serious tone, “Senior Lin, from today onward, you’re my master. I’m willing to serve you with no regrets even if I die!”

Ma Zheng was a very smart person.

No merit, no reward.

As for a legendary thing like a King-level cultivation technique, he was simply unable to take out something that matched it.

He could only sacrifice himself!

“Alright!” Lin Fan said.

“I’ll give you a mission now. Join a large faction and continuously obtain greater power!”

“Yes, sir!” Ma Zheng said respectfully.

“Yes, the cultivation technique I’m teaching you is called the Primordial Fist,” Lin Fan said.

After a series of explanation and teaching, Ma Zheng finally remembered the Primordial Fist in his heart.

The soul communication ended here.

Ma Zheng, who was sitting in the cultivation room, slowly opened his eyes. His face revealed unconcealable joy.

It was not just because he had obtained a King-level skill, but it was also because he had become Lin Fan’s man.

Back then, when Ma Zheng and Lin Fan entered the Heavenly Wind World together, he already knew that Lin Fan was extremely powerful.

Later on, Ma Zheng was chased by the Bug Queen.

However, she died not long after.

Later on, the father of the Bug Queen, the king of the Bug Realm, also died suddenly.

Although Ma Zheng did not know how the Bug Queen and her father died, he had a feeling that these two things were related to Lin Fan.

To be able to kill two super powerful beings across space, just how strong was Lin Fan?

In Ma Zheng’s heart, Lin Fan was already a supreme existence that had transcended the world.

It was his destiny to work for such an existence.

That was right!

It was an opportunity!

…

After Lin Fan ended his conversation with Ma Zheng, he entered his cultivation state once again.

Three years passed in a flash.

In the past three years, Lin Fan had obtained three Immortal Crystals, two Transcendence Golden Bodies, and one Emperor-level skill from the system.

At the same time, his cultivation had also increased to a certain extent.

On this day, Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, he glanced at the system’s interpersonal relationships.

This was something that Lin Fan had been doing for the past few years.

He wanted to know the situation of his family.

Everything was normal.

Just as Lin Fan was about to retract his gaze, he suddenly saw Qiu Ziqian’s and Lin Yulian’s names flashing.

They had encountered danger!

Lin Fan’s face turned cold as he stared at their names.

Fortunately… their names only flashed for a few minutes before returning to normal.

However, Lin Fan still had to wait for an entire day before he could communicate with them.

“Ziqian, Yulian, what happened yesterday?” Lin Fan asked.

“A few days ago, we were accidentally seen by someone,” Qiu Ziqian said. “Then, we were intercepted. Fortunately, we managed to get rid of them for the time being.”

Lin Fan said, “Do you know who intercepted you?”

“I heard them say that their master seems to be called Lord Kadin,” Qiu Ziqian said.

Lin Fan nodded his head and said, “How is Yulian’s health now?”

“Dad, I only have that dream occasionally now. My body is much better than before. In addition, my cultivation has also started to increase!” Lin Yulian said happily.

Lin Fan said, “That’s good…”

The family of three chatted for a while more before ending their soul communication.

Lin Fan turned to the system and said, “Can I curse Kadin, who intercepted Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian?”

[The answer requires 10,000 spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes!”

[You can curse him.]

[Kadin: Level-five Universe cultivator. He’s the sect master of the Thunderbolt Sect. Because his subordinate discovered that Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian had treasures, he has the intention of snatching them and killing them.]

Snatching treasures?

Killing them?

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s face turned cold.

[Do you wish to use 1,000,000 spirit stones to curse Kadin?]

“Yes!” Lin Fan said without hesitation.

Instantly, a large number of spirit stones stored in the inner space shattered and turned into streams of light that disappeared.
